description: Stream::parseInt skips non-numeric characters, stops at the first character after the digits and keeps the characters it did not use.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: Stream::parseInt/peekNextDigit of the pinned core: non-digits are discarded until a digit arrives, a terminating character stays in the buffer, the 1 s timeout starts anew with every character
